answer: A bond of 45% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in nebula, and willow reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 139 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nectar account. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
